symbols: all targets in the selected coverage criterion
Coverage percentage.example: Executing 18 of 24 branches gives 75% branch coverage.

symbols: coefficient for the selected COCOMO mode
Basic COCOMO effort.example: Organic mode at 10 KLOC gives 2.4·10¹·⁰⁵ ≈ 26.9 person-months.

Schedule, staffing and labour cost.example: An effort of 24 person-months over 6 months needs 4 people on average. At ₹50,000 per person-month it costs ₹12 lakh.

symbols: points per item at its complexity
Unadjusted function points.example: Five low-weight external inputs at 3 each and two outputs at 4 each give 23 UFP.

Adjusted function points.example: DI=40 gives CAF=1.05, so 100 UFP becomes 105 AFP.

Forward pass.example: Predecessor finishes of 4 and 7 and duration 3 give ES=7 and EF=10.

symbols: allowed delay before the project finish is affected
Backward pass and float.example: With successor starts 12 and 15, duration 4 and ES=6, LF=12, LS=8, and total float=2.

symbols: squared spread of the duration estimate
PERT time and variance.example: O=2, M=5, P=8 gives tₑ=5 and variance=1.

Risk exposure.example: A 20% chance of a ₹50,000 loss gives risk exposure ₹10,000.

Mean failure and repair times.example: With 300 operating hours, 9 repair hours, 3 failures and 3 repairs, MTTF=100 h and MTTR=3 h.

Availability.example: 99 hours up and 1 hour down gives A=99/(99+1)=99%.

Failure rate and reliability.example: Two failures in 200 hours give λ=0.01 h⁻¹, and R(10 h)=e⁻⁰·¹≈0.905.
